content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Read the Employment Notification on https://rgu.ac.in/recruitments before filling in the portal. Apply online at https://rgunt.samarth.edu.in using the post code (71269 Internal Audit Officer, 71810 Executive Engineer). Forward the application through proper channel in the prescribed pro-forma with NOC, Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate and attested APARs of preceding 5 years. Application must reach The Deputy Registrar, Establishment, Administrative Block, Rajiv Gandhi University, Rono Hills, Doimukh-791112, Arunachal Pradesh by 4.12.2026 (5.00 PM). No correction is possible once the application is submitted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Internal Audit Officer, 1 Executive Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Internal Audit Officer: maximum 56 years; Executive Engineer: maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 12 (₹78,800–2,09,200) for Internal Audit Officer, Level 11 (₹67,700–2,08,700) for Executive Engineer.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Internal Audit Officer: officers of Audit and Accounts Services or similar organized Services holding analogous posts, or 3 years in Level 11, or 5 years in Level 10 in Audit and Accounts. Executive Engineer: First Class Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering with 08 years' experience as Assistant Engineer. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must be employees of All India Services, Central or State Govt. services, Autonomous organizations, Regulatory Authorities, Universities or Research Institutions etc. of Central/State Governments. Only candidates whose services can be spared immediately on selection should apply.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of eligibility for the post. Interaction with the Selection Committee constituted for the post. Candidates may be called for an interaction with the Selection Committee after scrutiny of eligibility. Call letters for written tests/interviews (wherever applicable) sent by email and placed on the University website.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation on Foreign Service terms initially for a period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance. Governed by DoPT OM No. 6/9/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. Pay/deputation (duty) allowance fixed as per DoPT instructions.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi University, Rono Hills, Doimukh, Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh.
